r206b_race_fix_review.finding: Private RLock covers super enqueue and all metadata/hash/assert assembly; ready becomes true last. Owner takes outside lock, then same-lock snapshot checks ready before deepcopy; no reset/Native until snapshot returns. Post-enqueue assembly failure marks request ERROR/fatal and ready remains false, so owner rejects before Native. No lock held during queue wait or Native execution. The r206 blocking race is resolved in source.
r206b_race_fix_review.CPU_contract: Inspected actual Bridge/snapshot AST test with real stdlib queue, controlled post-enqueue hash pause and failure case; directly targets the identified ordering issue without a new HTTP/Native framework. New actual CPU receipt still pending at review time; no GPU qualification claimed.
r206b_race_fix_review.execution: Proceed with already planned single r206b CPU preparation, then existing authorized formal-service path upon successful receipt. No added fixture/probe/reload gate.

blocking.finding: super.add_chat_request enqueues request before subclass attaches history_render_audit and other required admission metadata. Independent owner takes request then deep-copies metadata immediately. Hashing long prompt/ids may release GIL, permitting a snapshot without history_render_audit; final summary or history client can KeyError despite correct Model output. This is source-visible scheduling risk, not observed actual GPU failure.
blocking.minimal_fix: Publish full metadata before enqueue, or use one private admission lock covering super+metadata assembly and owner metadata snapshot after take; release before Native work. Fail closed on metadata assembly failure rather than allow an enqueued unaudited request to execute. No new framework/fixture/Nativeprobe needed.
